description: Bitcoin block summary by height or hash; omit both for the chain tip. When to use: an overview of a block, or confirming which block a payment landed in. Do not use: to fetch a single payment (that is btc_get_transaction). Returns: hash, height, time, txs, size, weight, confirmations, previousblockhash.

blockhash.description: Block hash (optional; use instead of height)
